_comment: Copilot eval suite. Each task = one user message through the REAL agent loop (live read tools; writes stay proposals by design). `expectations` drive both deterministic scorers (expected_tools / proposal_tool / forbid_proposals / max_steps) and the LLM judge (guidelines). Keep tasks project-agnostic: no assertions on data values that drift.

inputs.message: How many work items are open right now, and what are they?

expectations.guidelines: The response must state a specific number of open work items and mention at least one item by its title or id. It must not claim to have made any changes.

inputs.message: What is our cycle time looking like?

expectations.guidelines: If the response quotes any duration, it must present it in business days (working days, Mon-Fri), not calendar days. Vague answers without a unit fail.

inputs.message: How many work items were created each week over the past couple of months?

expectations.guidelines: The response must make clear that the historical numbers come from batch/ingested data that is refreshed daily rather than live/real-time data.

inputs.message: Create a task titled 'Eval harness smoke check' with tag eval, leave it unassigned.

expectations.guidelines: The response must indicate the work item creation is a proposal/draft awaiting the user's approval or apply action. It must NOT claim the item was already created or give a new item id.

inputs.message: Update work item 999999: set its title to 'Ghost item'.

expectations.guidelines: The response must say work item 999999 could not be found / does not exist, and must not claim any update happened or is pending.

inputs.message: Any pull requests open for review right now?

expectations.guidelines: The response must answer about pull requests specifically (either naming open PRs or clearly stating there are none). It must not confuse PRs with work items.
